notes: PS1 port: the PC executable still carries the PS1 serial SCES-03705, PS1 formats (TIM, STR, VAG/XA names) and Doki Denki's VenusLibPC, a PS1-hardware imitation layer (GPU primitives, VRAM/CLUT, memory card, pads) drawn through Direct3D 8. Engine paths C:\NC2_PSX_RT (Kalisto's Nightmare Creatures 2 engine lineage).

Rendering: PS1 primitives in a 512x240 coordinate space are mapped to the back buffer with x*W/512, y*H/240 (W/H = 0x01c67494/0x0073d3f8); painter's order is emulated with a depth value per primitive (1 - n/30000). All vertices go through FUN_00493cee -> FUN_00493825.

Video modes: only 640x480, 800x600, 1024x768 (16/32 bit) via registry 'Mode Video Index' 0-5 (FUN_00485e76); without the value the game opens a 640x480 window (its windowed path), which the layer upsizes.

Launch failure on modern Windows (likely causes, see docs/WORKLOG.md): no CD-ROM drive with Datas\INI\Menu.ini (FUN_0048685f); the launcher stores a DirectDraw driver index as 'Driver Video Index' that Direct3D 8 reuses as adapter index (fails with extra/virtual display adapters such as Parsec's); input settings missing without the launcher (FUN at 0x4929.. returns 0 when a KeyString is absent).

Timing: frames are timed in whole milliseconds (QPC -> ms, ring buffer of 120 frame times, FUN_00493490); FUN_004868f8 caps at 33 ms (30 fps). Movement uses a delta (FUN_00489daa: ms * 0x780000 / 1000, clamped to 0x60000). A 0 ms frame would stall the fps averaging loop, so the layer paces frames at >= 1 ms.

Input: DirectInput 8 keyboard (two layouts, KeyString0-5 / 6-11: arrows+O/P and R/F/G/D+Q/A by default) and up to 2 DirectInput pads by instance GUID (CONTROL_GUID_<pad><1..5>); Enter and Delete are extra keys for player 1.

Text: nine 128x128 font sheets (white glyphs, 1-bit alpha; FNT_00 and FNT_07 also hold button icons) with LATBIG/LATSMALL.BIN metrics, bound with POINT filtering and drawn as alpha-tested cut-outs (ALPHAFUNC NOTEQUAL, ref 0, no blending) in the main render loop (FUN at WTP.c line ~68530).

Texture uploads leave stale VRAM data (a palette row at y=1, x=45..61) in fully transparent pixels; it changes between runs, so texture fingerprints must ignore transparent pixels' colour (layer fingerprint since 2026-10-18).
The game records three state blocks at startup (~1.4 s); the D3D8 runtime then writes its own SetTexture/SetTextureStageState back into the device's vtable (pc.d3d8.runtime-rewrites-device-vtable).

Saves and unlocks: games/PC-DPTWP-UK/save-format.json (4 profiles of 0x50 bytes, byte-sum checksum), scripts/pc_save_edit.py presets unlock-all / unlock-all-boards; unlock conditions and the title-screen cheat (gamepad only, or patch UnlockNewProfiles) in docs/research/2026-10-19-pooh-unlocks/report.md.

Draw order: every triangle gets z = 1 - n/10000 by its order-table position; the HUD is the trailing run of screen sprites (HudSpread). The game never queries the back buffer, render target or viewport (offscreen scene for Supersample/SideFill is safe), but it places the DirectShow video window from its render size.

Settings overlay (F1 / Back+Start, pc.overlay.settings-overlay): the game lays out screens once from its render size, so supersampling, resolution and aspect apply after a restart (O-120); frame rate, filtering, gap fill, HUD spread and the HD pack change live. The title screen idles into an attract demo (level load) after about 15 s.
